senses.gloss: उलुप = उलप q. v.

उलूप, -पिन्
 See उलप, उलुपिन्.
उलुपिन् m. A guinea pig, porpoise; so उल(लू)पिन्.

उलूप, -पिन्
 See उलप, उलुपिन्.
ऊलुपिन् A porpoise; see उलुपिन्.

उलुलिः Ved. Howling, a howl; an outcry indicative of prosperity;
 पृथग् घोषा उलुलयः केतुमन्त उदीरताम् Av. 3. 19. 6.

—1 An owl; नोलूकोप्यवलोकते यदि दिवा सूर्यस्य किं दूषणम् Bh. 2. 93;
 त्यजति मुदमुलूकः प्रीतिमांश्चकवाकः Śi. 11. 64. cf. also कथमुलूकशब्द
 उलूकवचनः । रलयोः समानवृत्तित्वात् । ŚB. on MS. 9. 4. 22.
—2 N. of Indra.
—3 N. of a Muni (perhaps identical with कणाद, whose वैशेषिकदर्शन
 is called औलूक्य-दर्शन).
—4 (pl.) N. of a country and its king who was an ally of the Kurus.
उलूकः + .{@-जित्@} A crow.

उलूकः + .{@-यातुः@} A demon in the shape of an owl; उलूकयातुं शुशुलूकयातुम्
 Rv. 7. 104. 22.
उलूखलः A staff of Udumbara wood.

उलूखलः + .{@-लम्@}
—1 A wooden mortar used for cleansing rice (from the husk &c.); Rv. 1. 28. 6.
 अवहननायोलूखलम् Mbh.; वनस्पतिभ्य इत्येवं मुषलोलूखले
 हरेत् Ms. 3. 88, 5. 117.
—2 A kind of weapon; Mb. 7. 178. 23.
.━{@Comp.@}: उलूखलसुतः
उलूखलः + -सुतः the Soma juice pressed out in a (wooden) mortar; Rv. 1. 28. 1-4.

—1 A mortar; Rv. 1. 28. 5.
—2 Bdellium, a gummy substance or the plant which yields it. (Mar. गुग्गुळ).

उलूखलिक a.
—1 Pounded in a mortar.
—2 (At the end of comp.) Using as a mortar; दन्त˚ using the teeth
 as a mortar; Ms. 6. 17; Y. 3. 49.
उलूतः A large snake, the Boa (अजगर).

उलूपी A Nāga princess. [She was the daughter of the serpent Kauravya.
 While one day she was bathing in the Ganges, she happened to see Arjuna,
 and being enamoured of his handsome form, she managed to have him conveyed
 to her home, the Pātāla, and there induced him to take her as his wife,
 which he, after considerable hesitation, consented to do. She bore him
 a son named Irāvat. When Arjunaʼs head was cut off by Babhruvāhanaʼs
 arrow, it was with her assistance that he was restored to life; see Arjuna.]

उलूलि, -उलूलु a.
 Crying aloud, noisy (while joyous); तं जायमानं
 घोषा उलूलवोऽनूदतिष्ठन् Ch. Up. 3. 19. 3; Lāṭyāyana 4. 2. 9.

उलूलि, -उलूलु a.
 Crying aloud, noisy (while joyous); तं जायमानं
 घोषा उलूलवोऽनूदतिष्ठन् Ch. Up. 3. 19. 3; Lāṭyāyana 4. 2. 9.

उलूलुध्वनिः The noise of melodious chorus, especially of women, on
 happy occasions like the marriage festival; cf. उच्चैरुलूलुध्वनिमुच्चचार
 N. See उलुलिः.
उल्ल(लु)कसनम् Horripilation, erection of the hair of the body.

—1 Plucking out, cutting; पादकेशांशुककरोल्लुञ्चनेषु पणान् दश
 (दमः); Y. 2. 217.
—2 Plucking or pulling out the hair.

उल्लुण्ठनम्, उल्लुण्ठा
—1 Rolling, wallowing.
—2 Irony; धीराधीरा तु सोल्लुण्ठभाषणैः खेदयेदमुम् S. D. 105; सोल्लुण्ठम्
 ironically, often occurring as a stage-direction in plays.

उल्लुण्ठनम्, उल्लुण्ठा
—1 Rolling, wallowing.
—2 Irony; धीराधीरा तु सोल्लुण्ठभाषणैः खेदयेदमुम् S. D. 105; सोल्लुण्ठम्
 ironically, often occurring as a stage-direction in plays.
उल्लुण्ठित a. Rubbed against.

उल्लू^1 a. Cutting up.

ऊलूक = उलूक q. v.
